text: {"verdicts":[{"i":12,"v":"UNSUPPORTED","u":null,"why":"The patient mentioned his father had high blood pressure and died of bowel cancer, but there is no mention of the patient himself having hypertension or a history of it."},{"i":13,"v":"SUPPORTED","u":70,"why":"Patient explicitly states he lives alone and his occupation is software engineer."},{"i":14,"v":"SUPPORTED","u":79,"why":"Patient states he does not smoke and drinks alcohol infrequently, socially."},{"i":15,"v":"INFERRED","u":81,"why":"Doctor infers gastroenteritis based on the patient's symptoms of diarrhea, vomiting, and feeling unwell."},{"i":16,"v":"UNSUPPORTED","u":null,"why":"There is no mention of the patient taking regular paracetamol."},{"i":17,"v":"INFERRED","u":94,"why":"Doctor suggests a follow-up in 3-5 days or sooner if symptoms worsen."}]}
